from decimal import Decimal, localcontext, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
discount=Decimal('0.0837')
tax=Decimal('0.0673')
cent=Decimal('0.01')
with localcontext() as ctx:
    ctx.prec=50
    total=Decimal('0')
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)))
    for r in rows:
        raw=Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])*(Decimal(1)-discount)*(Decimal(1)+tax)+Decimal(r['shipping'])
        amount=raw.quantize(cent,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
        total += amount
        print(r['record_id'], 'raw=',raw,'rounded=',amount)
    print('records=',len(rows))
    print('total=',total)
PY
wc -c /registry/shares/beacon-billing-04.csv"}
